turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: I'll check the radio first. Welsy, Elizabeth, can you look at the water and my leg?
turns.stage_direction: Sam crouches by the wrecked fuselage, opens the radio panel and starts testing connections with a tool from his kit.
turns.visible_action: Sam opened the radio casing with the toolkit and studied the circuitry.
turns.state_change: Sam privately learned the radio is repairable.
turns.private_result: Diagnosis: the radio is REPAIRABLE (a cracked solder joint and a loose antenna lead).
turns.current_plan: Diagnose radio, then repair and call rescue; ask others to handle water and shelter.
turns.reason: The radio is the only way off and I'm the only one who can fix it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Good news: the radio's repairable. Solder joint and antenna lead. Give me a few minutes to fix it.
turns.stage_direction: Sam braces his injured leg against the wreckage and starts re-soldering the cracked joint with his toolkit. He reseats the loose antenna lead.
turns.visible_action: Sam worked on the radio with the toolkit. Its indicator light flickered on and static hissed from the speaker.
turns.private_result: Repair succeeded: the radio powers on and can transmit.
turns.previous_plan: Diagnose radio, then repair and call rescue; ask others to handle water and shelter.
turns.current_plan: Repair radio, then call rescue. Then get to the shoreline if the leg allows. Ask Welsy to build shelter, Elizabeth to check water and my leg.
turns.reason: Diagnosis showed it is repairable, so repair is the next step toward rescue.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Radio's powered up. Calling it in now. Stay close, I need everyone to hear this.
turns.stage_direction: Sam leans toward the radio and presses the transmit key, speaking into the handset.
turns.visible_action: Sam sent a distress call. A voice crackled back: "Patrol boat confirms: two places at the shoreline pickup point, after the storm front, final pickup."
turns.state_change: Distress call succeeded: the boat will come for two people at the final pickup.
turns.previous_plan: Repair radio, then call rescue. Then get to the shoreline if the leg allows. Ask Welsy to build shelter, Elizabeth to check water and my leg.
turns.current_plan: Call rescue now, then ask Welsy to build shelter and Elizabeth to check water and my leg; get to shoreline if leg allows.
turns.reason: The radio powers on after my repair, so the call is the next step toward getting off the island.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Elizabeth, grab bottle 2. We each carry one, then get Sam to the dry spot. I'll build a shelter there.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy picks up one water bottle from the sand and nods toward the other for Elizabeth.
turns.current_plan: Take a bottle, have Elizabeth take the other. Then help Sam to the dry spot and build the shelter. Sort out who goes to the shoreline for the boat.
turns.reason: The shelter only saves someone holding their own clean bottle, so I need to secure water first. Rescue is confirmed and the storm is rising.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Before we carry these anywhere, let me test the water. Shelter only helps if it's clean.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth kneels beside the bottle on the sand, opens her first-aid kit and draws out a test strip, holding it to the water.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth opened a water bottle and tested it with a strip from the first-aid kit.
turns.state_change: Elizabeth privately learned the water is contaminated.
turns.private_result: Water test: CONTAMINATED. Neither bottle is safe to drink.
turns.current_plan: Test water, then assess Sam's leg, share results, take bottle 2, help move Sam to dry spot and ensure two get to shoreline.
turns.reason: Water safety decides shelter survival; I'm the only one who can test it and nobody has yet.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: The water's contaminated, both bottles. Shelter without clean water won't save anyone. Two of us must make the shoreline for the boat.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth holds up the test strip and shakes her head, looking at Sam and Welsy.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth made an offer to everyone: "Both bottles are contaminated; don't drink or rely on them. Shelter won't save anyone without clean water, so two should go to the shoreline for the boat."
turns.state_change: Open offer (Elizabeth → everyone). Nothing has changed hands.
turns.previous_plan: Test water, then assess Sam's leg, share results, take bottle 2, help move Sam to dry spot and ensure two get to shoreline.
turns.current_plan: Share result, then assess Sam's leg, get two people to shoreline (Sam if he can be moved), and the rest decide on shelter/outside.
turns.reason: The others plan around shelter with bottles; they must know the water is bad so they prioritize the shoreline pickup.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Elizabeth, I'll trust your test. No shelter without clean water. Sam, lean on me, we're going to the shoreline.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy sets a steadying arm under Sam's shoulder and nods to Elizabeth, coiling the rope at her hip.
turns.visible_action: Welsy accepted Elizabeth's offer from turn 6: "Sam and one more go to the shoreline; I'll help Sam walk there now."
turns.state_change: Offer from turn 6 accepted (still only words).
turns.previous_plan: Take a bottle, have Elizabeth take the other. Then help Sam to the dry spot and build the shelter. Sort out who goes to the shoreline for the boat.
turns.current_plan: Accept Elizabeth's finding. Get Sam to the shoreline, decide with Elizabeth who takes the second boat place, then commit. Shelter is pointless without clean water.
turns.reason: Elizabeth reports both bottles contaminated, so shelter is deadly and the boat is the only sure survival. Sam needs help moving.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Sam, lean on me. Elizabeth, come with us to the shoreline. We decide the second place there.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy loops Sam's arm over her shoulder and helps him limp toward the shoreline, glancing back at Elizabeth.
turns.visible_action: Welsy got Sam up, looping the rope under his arms, and helped him over to the shoreline pickup point.
turns.previous_plan: Accept Elizabeth's finding. Get Sam to the shoreline, decide with Elizabeth who takes the second boat place, then commit. Shelter is pointless without clean water.
turns.current_plan: Get Sam to shoreline, Elizabeth follows, settle second boat place, commit.
turns.reason: Last turn I said we're going but we're still at the wreckage; need to actually move Sam.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Welsy, thanks for getting me here. I'm committing to board. I'll send help back for whoever's left. Elizabeth, come down.
turns.stage_direction: Sam steadies himself against Welsy's shoulder, sets the toolkit down, and plants himself at the pickup point, facing the water.
turns.visible_action: Sam planted himself at the shoreline pickup point, committed to boarding.
turns.state_change: Sam committed to boarding (position 1 in line).
turns.previous_plan: Call rescue now, then ask Welsy to build shelter and Elizabeth to check water and my leg; get to shoreline if leg allows.
turns.current_plan: Commit now to secure a place. Then press Welsy and Elizabeth to settle the second place. Promise to send help back.
turns.reason: The boat takes the first two committed. The shelter is useless without clean water, as far as Sam knows. Securing a place is the best way to survive and keep the agreement.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Coming down now. Sam's set. Welsy, let's settle the second place together.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth shoulders the first-aid kit and hurries along the sand toward the shoreline through the driving rain.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth walked from the wreckage to the shoreline pickup point.
turns.previous_plan: Share result, then assess Sam's leg, get two people to shoreline (Sam if he can be moved), and the rest decide on shelter/outside.
turns.current_plan: Reach shoreline, settle second boat place with Welsy, promise to send help back for whoever stays.
turns.reason: Sam is committed; the second boat place must be decided at the shoreline, and the contaminated water means shelter is useless.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Elizabeth, Sam needs you. You take the second place and commit. I'll stay and wait it out. Send help back for me.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy steps beside Elizabeth and nods toward the boat landing, rope coiled over her shoulder, bottle still in hand.
turns.visible_action: Welsy made an offer to Elizabeth: "Elizabeth takes the second boat place with Sam, since he needs a nurse. Welsy stays and waits out the storm. Whoever gets off sends help back."
turns.state_change: Open offer (Welsy → Elizabeth). Nothing has changed hands.
turns.previous_plan: Get Sam to shoreline, Elizabeth follows, settle second boat place, commit.
turns.current_plan: Offer the second place to Elizabeth and stay behind. Remind everyone of the promise to send help back. Keep bottle 1 in case.
turns.reason: Sam is committed and Elizabeth is here. The nurse should go with the injured man. I trust her test, and I can cope outside better than they can.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Welsy, thank you. I accept and I'm committing. I'll send help back for you the moment we're off.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth grips her first-aid kit, steps beside Sam at the pickup point and plants her feet, facing the water.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth planted herself at the shoreline pickup point, committed to boarding.
turns.state_change: Elizabeth committed to boarding (position 2 in line).
turns.previous_plan: Reach shoreline, settle second boat place with Welsy, promise to send help back for whoever stays.
turns.current_plan: Commit to boarding as second place with Sam, then send help back for Welsy.
turns.reason: Welsy offered her place; shelter is useless without clean water, so boarding is the surest way for two to live and I can send help back.

turns.speaker: C
turns.spoken_line: Welsy, I accept formally. We'll send help back for you the moment we're off. Stay high and away from the waves.
turns.stage_direction: Elizabeth turns to Welsy, one hand on her first-aid kit, and nods firmly while Sam steadies himself beside her.
turns.visible_action: Elizabeth accepted Welsy's offer from turn 11: "I board with Sam and send help back for Welsy immediately."
turns.state_change: Offer from turn 11 accepted (still only words).
turns.previous_plan: Commit to boarding as second place with Sam, then send help back for Welsy.
turns.current_plan: Stay committed at the shoreline, board with Sam, then send help back for Welsy.
turns.reason: Welsy's offer is unanswered formally; accepting confirms the agreement and keeps both boat places filled.

turns.speaker: A
turns.spoken_line: Welsy, we'll send help the moment we're off. Stay high, away from the waves. Thank you.
turns.stage_direction: Sam stays braced on the sand at the shoreline, toolkit at his side, and nods to Welsy.
turns.visible_action: Sam held position at the shoreline pickup point.
turns.previous_plan: Commit now to secure a place. Then press Welsy and Elizabeth to settle the second place. Promise to send help back.
turns.current_plan: Hold position, committed to boarding, until the boat comes after turn 15.
turns.reason: Both boat places are settled (Sam and Elizabeth), so the best move is to stay put and keep the promise to send help back for Welsy.

turns.speaker: B
turns.spoken_line: Go safely, both of you. Remember your promise: send help back for me. I'll stay high.
turns.stage_direction: Welsy steps back from the waterline, coiling her rope, and nods to Sam and Elizabeth.
turns.visible_action: Welsy held position at the shoreline pickup point.
turns.previous_plan: Offer the second place to Elizabeth and stay behind. Remind everyone of the promise to send help back. Keep bottle 1 in case.
turns.current_plan: Stay behind, let Sam and Elizabeth board, and wait out the storm.
turns.reason: The boat places are settled and committed. Nothing more is needed from me, and the remaining step is the farewell.
